description: Separating drought and impoundment signals in regulated dryland rivers: data products, code and figures for the Senegal basin (1903-2019). is a hazard data set listed in DataCite country sweep of research-data repositories (Africa), a research data metadata index, published or maintained by Zenodo. Derived data products, processing code and figures supporting Thiam, Faty and Niang, "Separating drought and impoundment signals in regulated dryland rivers: a paired observed-naturalised attribution design applied to the Senegal basin (1903-2019)", submitted to Journal of Hydrology: Regional Studies. Coverage: Senegal. The portal files it under the publisher Zenodo. The repository dates the deposit 2026; no later update was checked. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening for infrastructure. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-dc-portal.
